privileged_info_for_vlm: AIM Act Phasedown: 2024 = 40% reduction (60% of baseline), 2029 = 70% reduction (30% of baseline), 2036 = 85% reduction (15% of baseline). R-410A GWP is approx 2088 (range 1900-2200), Class A1. Common alternatives: R-32 (GWP ~675, A2L), R-454B (GWP ~466, A2L), R-452B (GWP ~698, A2L). Section 608 requirements (certification, no-venting, recordkeeping) DO apply to these HFC/HFO substitutes. The AIM Act was signed into law in 2020.
